prompt: I have a CSV of daily measurements in white_noise.csv. I want to run full diagnostics before I try to build a forecast model - can you tell me whether there is any structure worth modelling?
assertions: diagnostics.json contains forecastability.is_white_noise equal to true
diagnostics.json contains forecastability.forecastable equal to false
diagnostics.json contains stationarity.adf_stationary equal to true
diagnostics.json contains seasonality.is_seasonal equal to false
diagnostics.json contains trend.direction equal to flat
The response mentions not forecastable or white noise
